assumptions.coverage: Price coverage divides fully priced modeled awarded MWh by modeled awarded MWh. Award-node evidence requires both node/hour endpoints in actual market PTP awards; it is not actual awards to this strategy or exact directed-pair award coverage.
assumptions.deenergized_lists: Frozen S1 outcome-only restriction; not reused as pre-deadline node-selection information.
assumptions.grid: S1 causal monthly empirical DA ridge and frozen connected-basket cash model; not a physical network simulation.
assumptions.nodes: Frozen S1 incumbent plus capped C/G additions. Historical operating-day eligibility is not fully certified; endpoint evidence is not proof of strategy execution.
assumptions.prices: Frozen S1 pda/prt quote-bank contract; individual historical publication vintages remain incompletely certified.
assumptions.settlement: Round-six-decimal price-taking DA spread <= bid; explicit outcome-only restriction. Unvalued awarded exposure is retained.
assumptions.sizing: Continuous S1 history from 2021-01-01; no event-start reset. RAW_FULL cash and uniform-warning histories remain separate.

cost_basis: before costs; no market-impact model; current published quantities
evidence_basis: retrospective diagnostic; not executed trades or independent validation
